input: Clear and organize the garage storage shelves

gold.taskTitle: Clear and Organize Garage Storage Shelves
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to clear out and organize the storage shelves in their garage.

questions.title: How many shelving units are you working with?
questions.description: Understanding the number of shelving units helps gauge the scale of the project.

questions.title: What is currently stored on the shelves?
questions.description: Knowing the types of items (tools, sports gear, boxes, etc.) shapes the sorting and organizing strategy.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or target completion date?
questions.description: A deadline determines how urgently the plan needs to be structured and how many sessions to schedule.

questions.title: Are you open to donating, selling, or discarding items?
questions.description: Knowing whether decluttering is part of the goal affects how items will be sorted and handled.

questions.title: Do you already have bins, labels, or storage supplies?
questions.description: Existing supplies determine whether purchasing organizational tools is a required step.

questions.title: Is there a specific system you want the shelves organized by?
questions.description: Understanding the preferred organization logic (by category, frequency of use, person, season, etc.) guides the final layout.

questions.title: Will you be doing this alone or with help from others?
questions.description: Knowing who is involved affects how tasks are divided and how long the project will realistically take.
